english: Word reached Basium that the battle for Tempus Mor was nearing an end. The eternal war was going well in this theatre, when disaster struck. An assassin from the Astur Wastes, that dismal marshland far to the south beyond the Deruptus Mountains, took both the life and the soul of his patron. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The archangel did not mind the end of a mortal life, but he mourned the loss of a soul that should have risen to join his ranks forever. Her spirit was strong, the sort that might turn the tide of the war. He thought it was a pity that such a soul had been wasted on a mere mortal woman, rather than a True Angel, and an grave injustice that it should now serve another. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Mercurian commander knew more of these accursed Shades than any mortal, more even than they knew of themselves. They began as a people devoted to his own creator, Arawn, although the God of Death himself was always indifferent to them. Basium knew they has betrayed their lord, and did not consider their ignorance of this fact to be a excuse. "They might not be demons," thought Basium, "or even the undead, but they are indeed a corruption that must be purged from existence. "[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Stop!" commanded Gyra, as she materialized to block her twin's path. "You shall not destroy a people under my protection! Their reverence for Arawn is strong. The Compact would not stop me from sending legions of Arawn's Dullahan to protect them!. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basium laughed. "The Compact! What do I care about that old agreement. I rejected it from the start, and am constrained by it no more than a mortal. Besides, I lead the armies of Arawn! Do you not see them? Your pitiful band is no match for mine, and we both know that our maker would never lend you more support. He cares for the prayers of the living no more than a man cares for the prayers of a bug. Would he permit you to guard the thralls of The Pretender? I am not ignorant, dear sister. My Dullahan attest that the soul of Queen Ethne, like all the victims of the Netherblade, are bound not merely to the Netherworld, but to the Kingdom of Laroth; they are being recruited into the resistance. "[PARAGRAPH]"Remember the terms of your fall, dear brother," Gyra rejoined. "You are indeed as constrained as any mortal. Mortals die, and their souls are collected. I can see to it that this happens to you. I would gladly escort your spirit to a cell in our maker's vault. Have you seen Anesidora lately? Time has not been kind to her. Without the divine spark of The One passed down through the children of Nemed, eons as my inmate will not be kind to you either. [PARAGRAPH]Yet that would be a mercy. I should serve your warrant from The Divine Court. Dadga would not risk your escape from Alius Orbis. The portals you once guarded might only let you return here as an unborn babe. You would forget most of who you were before you grow enough to lead armies again, and in the meantime would be vulnerable to the corruptions of the flesh, but too much your purpose would remain. The Court would surely rule you must be remade, stripped of all your memories and made to wander the Wildlands as a mindless beast. Perhaps you could bow before Sucellus, swear to guard the Font of Life for the theif who stole it, and beg "the God of Daisies" so ask court for clemency? I think not. [PARAGRAPH]It is Death the Sidar worship. Arawn is in no condition to help them, but I will not turn away from that responsility. [PARAGRAPH]Take your renegade armies of Life and go. Half of them would abandon you anyway if you diverted them towards this quest. They don't serve you any more than you serve Arawn, or Sucellus. They only follow you for a chance to slay demons. Are all the demons vanquished aready? Funny, it seems like I would have noticed if the Fane of the Lesser's had been closed. No, I believe it is still in business, still trapping souls that belong to my master in order to feed the great machine of hell. Tell you what: I'll handle the Sidar my own way. I'll lead Decius to attack them and confiscate Laroth's blade, but he shall not be permitted to rule or exterminate them. They are to be left in peace after that. I shall handle Laroth myself. If that task is finished before you reach the Gates of Hell, I'll join in your assault. Would you agree to that Compact?" she teased. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basium was not amused, but he agreed to the terms and departed with his army unto the Fane of the Lessers.
chinese: 巴希姆得到消息，坦普斯·摩尔之战已近尾声。在这一战区，那场永恒之战进展顺利，却祸从天降。一名来自阿斯图荒原——那片远在德鲁普图斯山脉以南、阴森的沼泽湿地——的刺客，取走了他所庇护者的性命与灵魂。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]大天使并不介意一条凡人生命的终结，却为一个本该升入他麾下、永世追随的灵魂之逝而哀恸。她的灵魂强大，正是那种或能扭转战局的灵魂。他觉得可惜，如此一个灵魂竟被浪费在一个区区凡间女子身上，而非一位真天使，更觉得它如今要去侍奉他人，是天大的不公。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]这位天界军团的统帅比任何凡人都更了解这些该死的幽影，甚至比他们了解自己还要深。他们最初是一群献身于他自己的造物主阿劳恩的民族，尽管这位死亡之神本人始终对他们漠不关心。巴希姆知道他们背叛了自己的主上，且不认为他们对此一无所知便可作为借口。“他们或许不是恶魔，”巴希姆想，“甚至不是不死者，但他们确是一种必须从存在中涤除的堕落。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“住手！”盖拉喝令道，现身挡住了她孪生同胞的去路。“你不得毁灭一个在我庇护之下的民族！他们对阿劳恩的敬奉之心坚定。契约拦不住我派遣阿劳恩的无头骑士军团去保护他们！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]巴希姆笑了。“契约！我何曾在乎那纸旧约。我从一开始就摒弃了它，受它约束不比一个凡人更多。再说，我统领着阿劳恩的大军！你没看见他们吗？你那可怜的小队根本不是我的对手，你我都清楚，我们的造物主绝不会再多借你半分支援。他在乎活人的祈祷，不比一个人在乎一只虫子的祈祷更多。他会允许你去守护那‘僭越者’的奴仆吗？我并非无知，亲爱的妹妹。我的无头骑士可以作证：艾斯妮女王的灵魂，一如所有冥刃的受害者，不仅被缚于彼世，更被缚于拉罗斯的王国；他们正被招募进那支抵抗军。”[PARAGRAPH]“记住你堕落时的条款，亲爱的兄长，”盖拉回敬道。“你确实和任何凡人一样受着约束。凡人会死，他们的灵魂会被收取。我能让这一切也降临到你身上。我很乐意护送你的灵魂，去我们造物主宝库里的一间牢房。你近来见过阿涅西多拉吗？岁月待她可不温柔。没有经由尼米德子嗣传下的太一之神性火花，作为我的囚徒度过亿万年，也不会待你温柔。[PARAGRAPH]然而那还算是慈悲。我该执行神圣法庭对你的判令。达格达不会冒险让你从异界脱逃。你曾守护的那些传送门，或许只会让你以未出生婴孩的形态返回此地。你会忘却自己成长到能再度统军之前的大半过往，其间还将受肉身诸般堕落的侵蚀，可你太多的宿命仍会留存。法庭定会裁决你必须被重塑，剥去一切记忆，作为一头无心智的野兽在蛮荒之地游荡。或许你能拜倒在苏塞鲁斯面前，向那盗取生命之泉的窃贼起誓守护它，再乞求‘雏菊之神’向法庭为你求情？我看不会吧。[PARAGRAPH]希达人所崇拜的是死亡。阿劳恩无力相助他们，但我不会背弃那份责任。[PARAGRAPH]带上你那支叛逆的生命大军走吧。你若把他们调去执行这桩使命，其中一半反正也会弃你而去。他们侍奉你，不比你侍奉阿劳恩或苏塞鲁斯更多。他们追随你，只为一个斩杀恶魔的机会。难道恶魔都已被剿灭干净了？可笑，若‘次等者之殿’当真关了门，我想我会有所察觉才对。不，我相信它仍在营业，仍在困住那些本属我主上的灵魂，用以喂养地狱那台庞大的机器。这么办吧：希达人由我用自己的方式来处置。我会引德西乌斯去攻打他们、没收拉罗斯的刀刃，但不会准许他统治或灭绝他们。此后他们须得安宁。拉罗斯由我亲自处置。若这桩差事在你抵达地狱之门前便已了结，我便加入你的攻势。你可愿同意这份‘契约’？”她揶揄道。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]巴希姆并不觉得好笑，但他答应了这些条款，率军朝‘次等者之殿’而去。

english: The war has been a true disaster for our people, every hardship brings with it an opportunity for new growth. It will take generations for the world to recover, but eventually all good things shall come back stronger that they were before. Now that the Mercurian armies march off to fight evils elsewhere, it is our duty to help this land recover.
chinese: 这场战争对我们的族人而言是一场真正的灾难，然而每一场苦难都带来新生长的契机。世界需要数代人才能复原，但一切美好之物终将比从前更强大地归来。既然天界军团已开拔去别处征讨邪恶，助这片土地复原便是我们的职责。

english: The damage from this conflict was greater than expected, but at least Queen Viconia had her victory. The elven nation would soon fully submit to her, and she could focus on vanquishing her "allies. " Her assassins had already executed most of the ritualists who summoned Hyborem, and she had an amazing trap planned for the next meeting of the Undercouncil. It might not actually be possible to truly kill Os-Gabella, but she would sure enjoy seeing her try to escape from a coffin of mithril and nullstone. Forces had already been dispatched to The Dead Lands to stop Os-Gabella's ally Tebryn Arbandi from completing his world ending rituals. Faeryl looked quite pleased as she walk out onto the dais to address her court. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Just as she began her speech, the crowd was shocked to see an assassin materialize behind their queen and stab her straight through her heart. They were then surprised to see the assassin vanish as quickly as he appeared. Those who knew Faeryl were not surprised to see the illusion of her corpse dissolve shortly after the assassin had left. Soon the assassin was surprised to find himself caught in the web of a giant spider, with the real Faeryl staring down at him in glee. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Not a bad try," she said, "for a human. It's not nearly as elegant as Rivanna's last few attempts on my life, but better than some from the newer members of my personal guard. The invisibility was a nice touch, but you relied too heavily on it and got sloppy. How about you tell me who sent you so I can show your people how assassination is supposed to be done? No? Oh, well, I guess I'll just have to find some other way to have fun. "
chinese: 这场冲突造成的破坏超出预料，但维康莉亚女王至少赢得了她的胜利。精灵之国很快便会彻底臣服于她，她便能专心去铲除她的‘盟友’了。她的刺客已处决了大多数召唤海勃雷姆的仪式施法者，她还为下一次地下议会的会议筹划了一个绝妙的陷阱。要真正杀死奥斯·加贝拉或许根本不可能，但她定会乐于看她试图从一具秘银与虚空石打造的棺材里挣脱。已有部队被派往‘死亡之地’，去阻止奥斯·加贝拉的盟友特布里恩·阿尔班第完成他那毁灭世界的仪式。菲尔蕾尔走上高台向她的宫廷致辞时，神情颇为得意。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她刚开口讲话，人群便震惊地看见一名刺客在他们女王身后现身，一刀直穿她的心脏。他们随即又惊讶地看见那刺客如现身时一般迅速消失。认得菲尔蕾尔的人则不惊讶地看见，刺客离开后不久，她那具尸体的幻象便消散了。很快，刺客便惊讶地发觉自己落入了一只巨型蜘蛛的网中，真正的菲尔蕾尔正幸灾乐祸地俯视着他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“作为一个人类，”她说，“这一手还不赖。远不如瑞安那此前几次对我的行刺那般优雅，但胜过我亲卫中一些新成员的手笔。隐形是个不错的花招，可你太过依赖它，结果露了破绽。不如你告诉我是谁派你来的，好让我示范给你的族人看，行刺该是怎么个行法？不说？哦，好吧，那我只好另寻别的乐子了。”

english: The Overcouncil has been crushed, and the lands of Tempus Mor infected with a taint that will in time spread to merge all Erebus with hell. It has become a new Fane of the Lessers, though I shall not allow lesser demon lords access to his foothold.
chinese: 监理议会已被粉碎，坦普斯·摩尔的土地染上了一种污秽，它终将扩散，把整个埃瑞布斯与地狱融为一体。这里已成为一座新的‘次等者之殿’，不过我绝不会容许次等的魔王们踏足他的这处据点。

english: O Great Lord of the Balors, an imp announced, trembling in fear before Hyborem's might. "Our ally Decius has brought his own enemies to this fight. From the Bannor lands come the Order's hunter, Valin Phanuel, hunting demons and heretics. He ambushed the sect stationed by the southern pass, and vanquished it utterly. I was allowed to escape only to deliver his threats to Commander Achare, but of course I have chosen to inform you first. "[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Enraged by the news, the archangel slammed the messenger against the palace wall, breaking his wings and causing him to cough up black blood. "Send him your message then," he said, as he hurled the dazed imp through a portal to the Calabim camp.
chinese: “噢，巨角炎魔的伟大主上，”一个小恶魔通报道，在海勃雷姆的威能前战栗不已。“我们的盟友德西乌斯把他自己的敌人也引到了这场战事中。班诺尔的土地上，来了秩序教派的猎手瓦林·帕努埃尔，猎杀恶魔与异端。他伏击了驻守南方隘口的那个教派分部，将其彻底剿灭。他放我逃走，只为向阿卡雷指挥官转达他的威胁，但我当然选择先来禀报您。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]大天使被这消息激怒，把信使猛掼在宫墙上，折断了他的双翼，令他咳出黑血。“那就给他捎去你的口信吧，”他说着，将这被震得发懵的小恶魔掷入一道通往卡拉比姆营地的传送门。

english: Our spies have informed me that the Bannor have sent a great champion of the Order to aid the Elohim in their war against the Infernal. While their welfare is not a top priority, we should ready an assassin to take him out should he venture into the Umbrawood.
chinese: “我们的密探禀报，班诺尔已派出秩序教派的一位伟大冠军斗士，去助埃洛希姆人对抗地狱军团之战。虽然他们的安危并非头等要务，但我们应备好一名刺客，一旦他胆敢踏入幽影林，便取他性命。”

english: Excellent news my queen: we may now have another ally. The Bannor have not yet sent the army we requested to aid in the war against the Sheaim and Infernal, but they have sent their great hero Valin Phanuel as an advance guard. He has already annihilated a sect stationed near the southern pass of Tempus Mor. This may not directly effect the battle for the Umbrawood, but it may distract Hyborem long enough for us to prepare a defense for the heartland.
chinese: “好消息，我的女王：我们或许又多了一个盟友。班诺尔尚未派来我们所请求、援助对抗塞安与地狱军团之战的军队，但他们派出了他们伟大的英雄瓦林·帕努埃尔作为先遣。他已歼灭了驻守坦普斯·摩尔南方隘口附近的一个教派分部。这或许不会直接影响幽影林之战，但或许能牵制海勃雷姆足够久，让我们得以为腹地备好防御。”

english: Terrible news my queen: a great champion has risen up in service of the Ashen Veil. A former Bannor Oathtaker has renounced all virtue and been anointed with blood and equipped with armour bearing the darkest demonic runes. We can only hope that is grudge against our ally Decius keeps him too busy fighting the Malakim to focus his intention on the Umbrawood.
chinese: “噩耗，我的女王：一位伟大的冠军斗士已崛起，效命于灰烬帷幕。一名昔日的班诺尔誓言骑士弃绝了一切美德，受了血的涂膏，披上刻着最黑暗恶魔符文的甲胄。我们只能寄望他对我们盟友德西乌斯的宿怨，能让他忙于与马拉基姆人交战，无暇把心思放到幽影林上。”

english: Our spies report that a renegade Bannor Oathtaker by the Rosier has just been anointed as a champion of the Ashen Veil, and now rides out against our foes. Keep and eye on him, and prepare an assassin to take his life once our mutual enemies are defeated.
chinese: “我们的密探禀报，一名叛离的班诺尔誓言骑士，名唤罗希尔，刚受膏为灰烬帷幕的冠军斗士，如今正出击对付我们的仇敌。盯紧他，并备好一名刺客，一旦我们共同的敌人被击败，便取他性命。”

english: The Queen of Storms has come to us to share a plan that she and the Svartalfar have devised to stir discord in the Overcouncil. We are all to keep Commander Decius out of the inner circle of the Undercouncil, isolate him and encourage his relations with the druidess Talia Gosam. To hurry this along, we have decided to let Duke Sallos send his most subtle servants to the Calabim camp to inflame the desires of their flesh.
chinese: 风暴女王前来与我们分享一个她与斯瓦塔尔法所谋划、旨在在监理议会中挑起不和的计划。我们都要把德西乌斯指挥官排除在地下议会的核心圈子之外，孤立他，并撮合他与德鲁伊塔利亚·哥萨姆的关系。为加快这一进程，我们已决定让萨洛斯公爵派他最擅隐匿的仆从潜入卡拉比姆营地，撩拨他们肉体的欲望。

english: By the Sheaim's request, the Queen of Sorrows herself has been enlisted to whisper into Talia's ear and claim her soul. Soon Varn shall loose that which he loves most, and the Overcouncil shall be broken.
chinese: 应塞安人之请，悲痛女王亲自出马，去往塔利亚耳边低语、攫取她的灵魂。不久，范恩将失去他最珍爱之物，而监理议会也将就此瓦解。

english: Our spies have confirmed that Talia now comes often to the bed of Decius, and leaves again quite satisfied. Our progress has been reported to the Deathless Queen, who shall proceed to the next step of the operation soon.
chinese: 我们的密探已证实，塔利亚如今常来德西乌斯的床榻，离去时心满意足。我们的进展已上报给不死女王，她很快便会着手行动的下一步。

english: Arendel traveled to Golden Leane to attend the meeting of the Overcouncil, and chose to stay with the druidess whom Varn had married. Although Talia seemed eager to show off the oasis and claimed to love the life their even more than the forest, Queen Phaedra was not convinced. There was clearly a loneliness within the woman's heart. Arendel believed this was from staying separated from the Fellowship for too long.
chinese: 阿伦德尔前往金色莱恩参加监理议会的会议，并选择留宿于范恩所娶的那位德鲁伊处。尽管塔利亚似乎急于炫耀那片绿洲，还声称自己爱那里的生活更甚于森林，费德拉女王却并不信服。这女人心中显然藏着一份孤寂。阿伦德尔认为，这是因她与绿叶结社分离得太久所致。

english: Just this front of the war on evil began to turn in our favor, the Overcouncil called a mandatory meeting to discuss the progress. Why must I waste my time listening to mortal men and women prattle on, exchanging worthless pleasantries and coy glances while there is a war to wage? I swear that these mortals have too much of the spirit of compromise in them. I made it clear that I would not let them be such fools as to end this war early, and then stormed out.
chinese: 这条讨伐邪恶的战线刚开始转向对我们有利，监理议会便召开了一场必须出席的会议来讨论进展。战事当前，我为何非得浪费光阴，听凡间的男男女女喋喋不休、交换毫无价值的寒暄与含情脉脉的眼神？我敢说这些凡人身上有太多妥协的习气。我明明白白地表示，绝不会容他们蠢到早早结束这场战争，随后便拂袖而去。

english: Ethne began to explain to the Mercurian commander why the Speaker of the Overcouncil had recently been changed, but he dismissed the matter as trivial mortal politics and returned to the front lines.
chinese: 艾斯妮开始向天界军团的统帅解释监理议会的议长为何新近换人，但他把此事斥为无关紧要的凡间政治，转身回了前线。

english: Arendel was surprised to at the absence of both Varn and Talia Gosam from the latest Overcouncil meeting, but was too polite to ask why the other elves were missing.
chinese: 阿伦德尔对范恩与塔利亚·哥萨姆双双缺席最近一次监理议会会议颇感意外，却出于礼貌，没有追问其他精灵为何不见踪影。

english: Haste - the first level Body spell increases the movement rate of living units.
chinese: 急速——这道一阶体系法术能提升活体单位的移动速度。

english: Pit Beast - The demon summoned by the second level Chaos spell is reasonably strong, and may start with all sorts of useful (or not no useful) random promotions, and their duration is extended with each living unit they kill. Beware though, because Pit Beasts are notoriously disloyal and hard to control. They may fight for you one turn, and against you the next.
chinese: 嗜血兽——由二阶混沌法术召唤的恶魔相当强悍，出场时可能带有各式各样有用（或没什么用）的随机晋升，且每击杀一个活体单位，其持续时间便会延长。不过要当心，因为嗜血兽出了名地不忠、难以控制。它们可能这一回合为你而战，下一回合便反戈相向。

english: You suddenly feel like a much younger man. No longer so set in your ways, you mind has been opened to learn from the unexpected. Surely this is the blessing of Amathaon. [PARAGRAPH]All spheres of magic have Affinity promotions that allow different spells with different Channeling promotions, but Creation is the only sphere where spells can only be cast with affinity. There is no Creation I, Creation II, or Creation III promotion that arcane units with access to Creation mana can learn from experience. The Creation spells are Muse, Summon Pixie, and Abundance. Muse and Abundance are very useful in cities but useless in dungeons. Pixies act like workers who can be sacrificed for production, culture, or research, but their only real value in this scenario is their ability to create Illusions to act as decoys. [PARAGRAPH]The main value of Creation affinity in this scenario is that the promotion may randomly grant you a Potion of Restoration, which can be used to heal your unit, remove any negative promotions, and restore casting ability.
chinese: 你忽然觉得自己年轻了许多。不再那么墨守成规，你的心智已敞开，得以从意外中学习。这想必是阿玛松的祝福。[PARAGRAPH]所有魔法领域都有亲和晋升，可配合不同的引导晋升施展不同的法术，但创造是唯一只能凭亲和施法的领域。没有创造 I、创造 II 或创造 III 这样、可供拥有创造能量的奥术单位凭经验习得的晋升。创造领域的法术是缪斯、召唤精灵与丰饶。缪斯与丰饶在城中极为有用，但在地牢中毫无用处。精灵的作用如同工人，可被牺牲以换取生产、文化或研究，但它们在此剧本中唯一真正的价值，是能制造幻象充当诱饵。[PARAGRAPH]创造亲和在此剧本中的主要价值在于，该晋升可能随机赐予你一瓶复原药剂，可用来治疗你的单位、移除任何负面晋升，并恢复施法能力。

english: Escape - The first level dimensional spell allows you to teleport yourself directly home to your capital city, or, in the case of this scenario, out of the Cave of the Ancestors. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Your trial is complete!
chinese: 遁走——这道一阶维度法术能让你直接瞬移回你的首都，或者，在此剧本中，瞬移出祖先之穴。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]你的试炼完成了！

english: Stoneskin - The second level Earth sphere spell allows you to build up a thick defensive layer of earth to wear as a second skin. This significantly improves your ability to withstand enemy attacks.
chinese: 石肤——这道二阶土系领域法术能让你筑起一层厚厚的防御性土壳，当作第二层皮肤来穿。这会显著提升你抵御敌方攻击的能力。

english: Enchanted Blade - The first level Enchantment spell allows you to enhance the weapons of melee units. It will not help Dain directly, but may improve some of his summons.
chinese: 附魔之刃——这道一阶附魔法术能让你强化近战单位的武器。它不会直接助益丹安，但或许能强化他的一些召唤物。

english: Rust - The first Entropy spell allows you to quickly corrode your enemy's weapons. It removed the Bronze Weapons, Iron Weapons, and Mithril Weapons promotions, and adds the Rusted promotion which makes enemies 10% weaker. Note however that Rusted is only applied to Melee units.
chinese: 锈蚀——这道一阶熵法术能让你迅速腐蚀敌人的武器。它会移除青铜武器、铁制武器与秘银武器晋升，并附加令敌人虚弱 10% 的‘生锈’晋升。不过请注意，‘生锈’只施于近战单位。

english: Temperance - the basic Force spell allows you to maintain such a balance as to be able to resist damage both holy and unholy
chinese: 节制——这道基础力法术能让你维持一种平衡，从而既能抵御神圣伤害，也能抵御不洁伤害

english: Slow - The basic Ice sphere spell gives enemy units a promotion that reduces their movement by one point. It can take some time to wear off, granting you or denying them a chance to run away.
chinese: 缓速——这道基础冰系领域法术会给敌方单位一个使其移动力减一的晋升。它需要一段时间才会消退，从而给你逃跑的机会，或是剥夺敌人逃跑的机会。

english: Summon Einherjar - The mid tier Law spell allows you to summon an angel who can guard your caster and gains increased duration whenever it defeats an enemy.
chinese: 召唤英灵——这道中阶律法法术能让你召唤一位天使，它可守护你的施法者，并在每次击败敌人时获得延长的持续时间。

english: Destroy Undead - The mid level Death spell directly deals Holy damage to units of the Undead race. Note that it does not discriminate friend from foe, and can harm your own undead summons as well.
chinese: 摧毁不死——这道中阶死亡法术会对不死种族的单位直接造成神圣伤害。请注意，它不分敌我，也会伤及你自己的不死召唤物。

english: Charm - The mid level Mind spell renders enemy units unable to attack, leaving them to wander around harmlessly.
chinese: 魅惑——这道中阶心灵法术会令敌方单位无法攻击，任其无害地四处游荡。

english: Bloom - The Nature 2 spell allows you to create a New Forest feature on the caster's tile. This will eventually grow into a normal Forest and if you have the Fellowship of the Leaves state religion may then grow into an Ancient Forest. This probably is not the most useful spell within a dungeon, however.
chinese: 催林——这道二阶自然法术能让你在施法者的地块上生成一处新森林地貌。它最终会长成普通森林，若你的国教是绿叶结社，则可能进而长成远古森林。不过，这在地牢里恐怕算不上最有用的法术。

english: Shadowwalk - The mid level Shadow spell allows you to use enemy roads, ignore the defenses of enemy buildings, and have a chance to withdraw from combat when you would otherwise be defeated.
chinese: 暗影行走——这道中阶暗影法术能让你使用敌方的道路、无视敌方建筑的防御，并在本会战败时有几率撤出战斗。

english: Blinding Light - The second Sun spell allows you to temporarily blind your opponents, rendering them immobile until their vision returns.
chinese: 致盲之光——这道二阶太阳法术能让你暂时致盲你的对手，令其在视力恢复前无法移动。

english: There is a meta magic rune on the door ahead. As you approach the rune flares up and pushes you back.
chinese: 前方的门上有一道超魔法符文。你一靠近，符文便骤然亮起，把你推了回去。

english: The Grigori people rallied to their own defense with greater ardor that the Illians and Doviello had ever thought possible. Their combined forces were mighty, but a few brave adventurers repeatedly drove them back. It seems now that Cassiel may never be vanquished by a mere mortal. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fortunately for Auric, the Philosopher-King was not the only archangel left in Erebus either. There are two who have been confined here for ages, betrayed by their own creators and forever denied an ara of protection. Though it takes great might to break through the prisons of the gods, the captives within would make a worthy sacrifice. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Arise Odio! The malice of modern man is great. As I channel it to you now it breathes breathes life back into your stony flesh. The Curse of Kilmorph shall not hold you long! Aeron abandoned you to her, but you have a new master now. Behold thy new god!"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The heart of Odio ignited and the muscles of his chest began to ripple, but he was still mostly rock, unable to see much less free himself. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The earth trembled as he uttered the words "How may I serve you my lord?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]With a sinister grin, Auric replied; "With your immortal soul. "[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]He plunged a copper dagger deep within the helpless demon's heart, and reveled as a stream of the foulest blood washed over him. Odio's screams caused distant mountains to collapse, but Auric was unmoved. Slowly, carefully, he completed the spell by pushing the daggers blade into his right hand, cutting his flesh and allowing his blood to mix with the dead archangel. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In that moment, in a thousand different places in Erebus prophets received visions of a Winter Wyrm swallowing the world. Priests were overcome with a sense of foreboding and a cool wind blew through even the warmest areas. Auric's ascension had begun.
chinese: 格利高里人以伊利安人和多维洛人从未想过可能的热忱奋起自卫。他们的联军强大，但几名勇敢的冒险者一再将其击退。如今看来，卡西尔或许永远不会败于区区凡人之手。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]对奥里克而言幸运的是，那位哲人王也并非埃瑞布斯仅存的大天使。有两位已被囚禁于此亘古之久，为他们各自的造物主所背叛，永远被剥夺了一方庇护的祭坛。尽管要冲破诸神的牢狱需要莫大的威能，但其中的囚徒会是值得的祭品。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“起来吧，奥迪奥！今人的恶意深重。当我此刻将它导引于你，它便把生命重新吹入你石化的血肉。基尔莫夫的诅咒困不住你多久！艾伦把你抛弃给了她，可你如今有了新的主人。瞧瞧你的新神吧！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥迪奥的心脏燃起，他胸膛的肌肉开始起伏，但他大半仍是石头，看不见东西，更遑论挣脱自身。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当他吐出“我该如何侍奉您，我的主上？”这几个字时，大地震颤起来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克阴森地咧嘴一笑，答道：“用你不朽的灵魂。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]他把一柄铜匕深深刺入这无助恶魔的心脏，纵情陶醉于一股最污秽的血液漫过自己之时。奥迪奥的惨叫令远山崩塌，奥里克却不为所动。他缓慢而谨慎地把匕首的刃推入自己的右手，割开血肉，任自己的血与这死去的大天使相融，完成了法术。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]那一刻，在埃瑞布斯千百个不同的地方，先知们都得到了一个寒冬巨蛇吞噬世界的异象。祭司们被一种不祥的预感所攫住，一股寒风吹过了即便最温暖的地方。奥里克的飞升已然开始。

english: The Grigori people rallied to their own defense with greater ardor that the Illians and Doviello had ever thought possible. Their combined forces were mighty, but a few brave adventurers repeatedly drove them back. It seems now that Cassiel may never be vanquished by a mere mortal. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fortunately for Auric, the Philosopher-King was not the only archangel left in Erebus either. There are two who have been confined here for ages, betrayed by their own creators and forever denied an ara of protection. Though it takes great might to break through the prisons of the gods, the captives within would make a worthy sacrifice. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Arise, Brigit the Shining! Thy starlight bonds are soon to be dissolved. The dark passion of your fallen mistress shall not go unopposed. Your service here will be invaluable. "[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"How may I serve your righteous cause," she intoned, with a melody that could fill all but the coldest hearts with love. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Righteous? Who said the cause was Righteous?" Auric grinned. " I am here to restore the ancient order, to return Winter to ascendancy. The flames of passion will have no place there, but are of use to be now. You shall serve me with your dying breath!"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Auric hurled the copper dagger from his side directly at the archangel's heart. It struck true. Brigit cried out less in pain than in exertion as he directed all her power at him in the form of white hot flames. Auric merely stepped back and allowed the Ring of Carcer to absorb the entire force of the blow. By the time the barrier had fully collapsed, Brigit lay helpless on the ground, completely exhausted. Auric strode forth and leaned over her dying form. He twisted the blade and watched the last of her shimmering blood drain out. Slowly, carefully, he completed the spell by pushing the daggers blade into his right hand, cutting his flesh and allowing his blood to mix with the dead archangel. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In that moment, in a thousand different places in Erebus prophets received visions of a Winter Wyrm swallowing the world. Priests were overcome with a sense of foreboding and a cool wind blew through even the warmest areas. Auric's ascension had begun.
chinese: 格利高里人以伊利安人和多维洛人从未想过可能的热忱奋起自卫。他们的联军强大，但几名勇敢的冒险者一再将其击退。如今看来，卡西尔或许永远不会败于区区凡人之手。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]对奥里克而言幸运的是，那位哲人王也并非埃瑞布斯仅存的大天使。有两位已被囚禁于此亘古之久，为他们各自的造物主所背叛，永远被剥夺了一方庇护的祭坛。尽管要冲破诸神的牢狱需要莫大的威能，但其中的囚徒会是值得的祭品。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“起来吧，光耀者布里吉特！束缚你的星光即将消散。你那堕落女主人的黑暗激情不会无人反抗。你在此的效力将是无价的。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我该如何侍奉您那正义的事业，”她以一种能令除最冷酷之心外的所有人满溢爱意的旋律吟诵道。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“正义？谁说这事业是正义的？”奥里克咧嘴一笑。“我在此是为了重建远古的秩序，让寒冬重归主宰。激情之火在那里将无处容身，但眼下尚有用处。你将以你临终的一息侍奉我！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克把身侧的铜匕径直掷向大天使的心脏。一击命中。布里吉特与其说是因痛楚、不如说是因竭力而惊呼，她把自己全部的力量化作白热的烈焰导向他。奥里克只是后退一步，任卡尔刻之戒吸收了这一击的全部力量。待那道屏障彻底崩解时，布里吉特已无助地倒在地上，彻底力竭。奥里克大步上前，俯身于她濒死的躯体之上。他扭动刀刃，看着她那闪光的血流尽最后一滴。他缓慢而谨慎地把匕首的刃推入自己的右手，割开血肉，任自己的血与这死去的大天使相融，完成了法术。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]那一刻，在埃瑞布斯千百个不同的地方，先知们都得到了一个寒冬巨蛇吞噬世界的异象。祭司们被一种不祥的预感所攫住，一股寒风吹过了即便最温暖的地方。奥里克的飞升已然开始。

english: Our scouts have found the location of the legendary Ring of Carcer! It is said that this is the prison where Bhall trapped her archangel Brigit the Shining when she refused to fall with her mistress. If we can get a unit strong enough to enter the Ring and free her, then we can use her blood for Auric's ritual.
chinese: 我们的斥候已找到传说中卡尔刻之戒的所在！据说那是一座牢狱，当光耀者布里吉特拒绝随其女主人一同堕落时，巴尔便将她的大天使囚禁于此。我们若能派一个足够强大的单位进入戒环、将她解放，便能用她的血来举行奥里克的仪式。

english: Our scouts have found the location of Odio's Prison! It is said that this great stone statue is actually the petrified form of Aeron's archangel. Odio was trapped like this as punishment for defying his lord's orders and going on a rampage against the worshipers of Kilmorph during the time of the truce that led to the signing of The Compact. If we can get a unit strong enough to free him, then his blood would be enough for Auric to complete his ritual.
chinese: 我们的斥候已找到奥迪奥牢狱的所在！据说这尊巨大的石像，实则是艾伦的大天使石化后的形态。奥迪奥之所以被如此囚禁，是为惩罚他违抗主上之命，在那段促成契约签订的休战期间，对基尔莫夫的信徒大肆屠戮。我们若能派一个足够强大的单位将他解放，他的血便足够奥里克完成他的仪式。

english: Description: Tebryn means to destroy the world. He has gathered his generals around him and has bent the power of the Dead Lands to his control. If Armageddon is to be prevented Tebryn must be stopped here. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Special Rules: Human units won't heal in this scenario. Human units that die are reborn as undead units under Tebryn's control. Tebryn's lands can't be entered until all the other Sheaim players are defeated. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires: Successful completion of the Radiant Guard scenario.
chinese: 描述：特布里恩意图毁灭世界。他已在身边聚齐了他的将领，并把死亡之地的力量弯折至他的掌控之下。若要阻止末日审判，就必须在此阻止特布里恩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则：本剧本中人类单位不会自愈。死去的人类单位会作为特布里恩控制下的不死单位重生。在其余所有塞安玩家被击败之前，无法进入特布里恩的领地。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]要求：成功完成‘光辉守卫’剧本。

english: Art Style
chinese: 美术风格

english: Malakim, Age of Rebirth, Chaos 3[PARAGRAPH]High priest of the Sons of Discord. One of the seven Aspects of War.[PARAGRAPH]A Calabim attack wiped out Seth's Malakim village when he was a boy. Alone, he retaliated, striking night after night at Calabim camps, forts and villages. Killing indiscriminately. He killed hundreds, and those that chased him out into the desert never returned. Among the Calabim he became known as "Dreamstealer" because he killed so many in their sleep. Most believed him to be a ghost or demon, not a teenage boy.[PARAGRAPH]Eventually Seth was caught (though they didn't know he was Dreamstealer) and placed in a Calabim slave mine. He toiled in that mine for 3 long years, making friends with only one other slave, a man named Petr. It was then that Camulos called to him, to form a new church upon Erebus. Seth accepted that call and cut out Petr's heart and sacrificed it to Camulos. In response Camulos caused a rage to fall upon the slaves and they rose up against the slavemasters. During that fight Seth escaped from the mine.[PARAGRAPH]Tired of the Calabim and the desert he traveled acting as a mercenary and assassin, and spent time among the Hippus and Lanun. He gathered men as he went and made them disciples of Camulos, forcing them to fight each other to the death to join his church. Forging his church from the bloody arena floor.
chinese: 马拉基姆，重生时代，混沌 3[PARAGRAPH]纷争之子的大祭司。战争七相之一。[PARAGRAPH]赛斯还是个男孩时，一场卡拉比姆人的进攻抹去了他的马拉基姆村庄。他孤身一人，展开了报复，夜复一夜地袭击卡拉比姆的营地、堡垒与村庄，不加区分地杀戮。他杀了数百人，那些追他进沙漠的人再没回来。在卡拉比姆人中，他被称为‘窃梦者’，因为他杀了太多在睡梦中的人。多数人以为他是鬼魂或恶魔，而非一个十几岁的少年。[PARAGRAPH]赛斯最终被抓（尽管他们并不知道他就是窃梦者），关进了一座卡拉比姆奴隶矿场。他在那矿场里苦役了漫长的三年，只与另一名奴隶——一个名叫佩特尔的人——结为朋友。就在那时，卡姆罗斯召唤了他，命他在埃瑞布斯建立一座新的教会。赛斯接受了那召唤，剜出佩特尔的心，献祭给了卡姆罗斯。作为回应，卡姆罗斯令一股狂怒降临于奴隶们，他们群起反抗奴隶主。在那场斗争中，赛斯逃出了矿场。[PARAGRAPH]厌倦了卡拉比姆人与沙漠，他四处游历，充当雇佣兵与刺客，在希普斯人与拉努恩人中待过一阵。他一路招揽人手，使他们成为卡姆罗斯的信徒，逼他们彼此死斗方能加入他的教会。他的教会，正是从那血染的竞技场地面上锻造而成。

chinese: 输入 MapFinder 每一轮循环中重新生成地图前延迟的秒数（默认值为 0.0）。

chinese: 设定筛选按钮的行为方式。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]PLE[COLOR_REVERT] - 选中的筛选器会把匹配的单位从视图中移除，且相关筛选器彼此独立运作（你可以同时选中负伤与健康，结果得到一个空视图）[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]BUG[COLOR_REVERT] - 选中的筛选器会把不匹配的单位从视图中移除，且相关筛选器互斥（选中负伤会取消选中健康，选中空中会同时取消选中陆地与海上）

english: PLE|BUG
chinese: PLE|BUG

english: Health Bar
chinese: 生命条

english: Shows a bar above the unit icon displaying the unit's health and damage.
chinese: 在单位图标上方显示一根条，标示该单位的生命值与所受伤害。

english: Hide During Combat
chinese: 战斗中隐藏

english: Hides the Health Bar when a unit is in combat.
chinese: 当单位处于战斗中时隐藏生命条。

english: Healthy
chinese: 健康

english: The color to use for the healthy portion of the bar.
chinese: 生命条中健康部分所用的颜色。

english: Wounded
chinese: 负伤

english: The color to use for the wounded portion of the bar.
chinese: 生命条中负伤部分所用的颜色。

english: Movement Bar
chinese: 移动条

english: Shows a bar above the unit icon displaying the unit's movement points.
chinese: 在单位图标上方显示一根条，标示该单位的移动点数。

english: Available
chinese: 可用

english: The color to use for the available movement portion of the bar.
chinese: 移动条中可用移动部分所用的颜色。

english: Used
chinese: 已用

english: The color to use for the used movement portion of the bar.
chinese: 移动条中已用移动部分所用的颜色。

english: Cannot Move
chinese: 无法移动

english: The color to use for the whole bar when the unit cannot move anymore.
chinese: 当单位再也无法移动时，整根条所用的颜色。

english: Wounded Dot
chinese: 负伤点

english: Darkens the dot in the upper-left corner of units that are wounded.
chinese: 将负伤单位左上角的圆点调暗。

english: Great General
chinese: 大将军

english: Places a star on units that are lead by a Great General.
chinese: 在由大将军统领的单位上标一颗星。

english: Promotion Available
chinese: 可晋升

english: Places a light blue border around units that can be promoted.
chinese: 在可晋升的单位周围加一圈浅蓝色边框。

english: Upgrade Available
chinese: 可升级

english: Places an orange up arrow on the lower-right corner of units that can be upgraded, ignoring cost.
chinese: 在可升级的单位右下角标一个橙色上箭头，不考虑费用。

english: Mission Tag
chinese: 任务标签

english: Places a tag below units showing their current mission (action).
chinese: 在单位下方标一个标签，显示其当前任务（行动）。

english: Horizontal Spacing
chinese: 水平间距

english: Specifies the horizontal spacing between icons (default value is 34).
chinese: 指定图标之间的水平间距（默认值为 34）。

english: Vertical Spacing
chinese: 垂直间距

english: Specifies the vertical spacing between icons (default value is 42).
chinese: 指定图标之间的垂直间距（默认值为 42）。

english: Enabled
chinese: 启用

english: Replaces the default Unit Info displayed when you hover over a unit.
chinese: 替换你悬停于单位上时显示的默认单位信息。

english: Horizontal Position
chinese: 水平位置

english: Specifies the horizontal position of the Unit Info hover pane (default value is 5).
chinese: 指定单位信息悬浮面板的水平位置（默认值为 5）。

english: Vertical Position
chinese: 垂直位置

english: Specifies the vertical position of the Unit Info hover pane (default value is 160).
chinese: 指定单位信息悬浮面板的垂直位置（默认值为 160）。

english: Promotion Icon Offset
chinese: 晋升图标偏移

english: Specifies the vertical offset of the promotion icons on the Unit Info hover pane (default value is 0, positive is up). Use this to adjust the placement of the icons when using themes that change the font. For example, use 6 with BlueMarble.
chinese: 指定单位信息悬浮面板上晋升图标的垂直偏移（默认值为 0，正值向上）。使用会改变字体的主题时，用它来调整图标的位置。例如，配合 BlueMarble 使用 6。

english: Unit Name
chinese: 单位名称

english: Color of the unit's name.
chinese: 单位名称的颜色。

english: Can Afford
chinese: 负担得起

english: Color of the upgrade cost when you can afford to upgrade the unit.
chinese: 当你负担得起升级该单位时，升级费用的颜色。

english: Cannot Afford
chinese: 负担不起

english: Color of the upgrade cost when you cannot afford to upgrade the unit.
chinese: 当你负担不起升级该单位时，升级费用的颜色。

english: Unit Type
chinese: 单位类型

english: Color of the specialties a unit has due to its type.
chinese: 单位因其类型而拥有的特长的颜色。

english: Promotion
chinese: 晋升

english: Color of the specialties a unit has due to its promotions.
chinese: 单位因其晋升而拥有的特长的颜色。

english: Move Highlighter
chinese: 移动高亮

english: Highlights the moves a unit can make when you hover the mouse over the unit's icon while holding [ALT].
chinese: 当你按住 [ALT] 并将鼠标悬停在单位图标上时，高亮该单位可移动到的位置。

english: Position of Scores
chinese: 分数位置

english: [ICON_BULLET]Wears off at end of turn
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]回合结束时消退

english: [ICON_BULLET]Makes the unit invisible (except in cities)
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]使单位隐形（城市中除外）

english: [ICON_BULLET]Requires level %d1 or higher
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]需要 %d1 级或更高

english: [ICON_BULLET]%D1[ICON_INSTABILITY] when stationed in a city
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]驻扎于城市时 %D1[ICON_INSTABILITY]

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The Revolution Watch Advisor screen is totally customisable in the same way as the Domestic Advisor Screen.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：革命监视顾问界面完全可定制，方式与内政顾问界面相同。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Customise the Revolution Watch Advisor to suit your playing style and imagination! Put the culture level column next to the Revolution trend column, it doesn't matter!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：按你的游戏风格与想象来定制革命监视顾问！把文化等级列放到革命趋势列旁边，无所谓的！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The Revolution Watch Advisor can also display important buildings constructed in a city that are relevant to Revolutions, especially cultural buildings like wonders, and theatres!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：革命监视顾问还能显示一座城市中与革命相关的重要建筑，尤其是奇观、剧院之类的文化建筑！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: City bribing can be initiated from the city screen or the Revolutions Watch Advisor screen.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：城市贿赂可从城市界面或革命监视顾问界面发起。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The civ info screen can now graph the overall revolt stability of your empire, or your enemies empire! You just need sufficient espionage points...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：文明信息界面如今能绘出你帝国、或你敌人帝国的整体叛乱稳定度曲线图！你只需有足够的谍报点数……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Pay attention to the underlying rebellion issues in your city! If the citizens are sick of slavery, you may need to do something about it or accept the consequences!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：留意你城市中潜藏的叛乱问题！若市民厌倦了奴隶制，你或许得为此做点什么，否则就承担后果！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Play Revolutions with an experimental mindset. Cause and effect are not necessarily immediately obvious...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：以试验的心态来玩革命。因果未必总是立竿见影……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you decide to go to war, make sure you have the peoples support! If you have chosen a bad target or get bogged down in the war, the people may drop their support for you!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你决意开战，务必确保你有民众的支持！若你选错了目标或陷入战争泥潭，民众可能会撤回对你的支持！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Running a deficit economy for too long, can make the people's approval of you decline. If you destroy the economy, you could well be destroyed!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：长期经营赤字经济，会使民众对你的支持率下降。你若毁了经济，很可能连自己也一并被毁！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Spend a surplus wisely. If you waste it, you may not have the money to buy bribes or pay for civic infrastructure vital to keep the people placid.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：明智地使用盈余。若你挥霍掉它，或许就没钱去买通人心、或支付那些对安抚民众至关重要的民生基建了。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Think of yourself at all times as being a servant of your people. They are your boss, whether you are running a democracy or a dictatorship!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：时刻把自己当作民众的公仆。无论你实行民主还是独裁，他们才是你的老板！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: In Revolutions, your potential opponent is not just your rival civ, but your own people...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：在革命中，你潜在的对手不只是你的对手文明，还有你自己的民众……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If your overall empire domestic stability is good, the world is your oyster!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你帝国整体的内政稳定良好，那便天下任你驰骋！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: When you have domestic problems, think of what has happened in real history to deal with those problems. It is no different in the game!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：当你面临内政问题时，想想现实历史上是如何应对这些问题的。游戏里也无二致！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: At some point, underlying rebellion can explode into violence no matter what you do. Be ready with law enforcement troops if needed!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：到了某个地步，无论你如何应对，潜藏的叛乱都可能爆发为暴力。若有需要，备好执法部队！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you face a revolt, don't panic. So long as you are not in the middle of a foreign war, you can apply military force on the rebels and gain experience!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你面临叛乱，别惊慌。只要你不是正陷于对外战争之中，你就能对叛军动用武力并获取经验！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: To protect your unstable cities, make sure you have law enforcement entrenched, and law enforcement units around the city too! Rebels will burn the countryside not just the city!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：要保护你不稳定的城市，务必确保执法力量已牢牢扎根，城市周边也部署有执法单位！叛军焚烧的不只是城市，还有乡野！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If a rebellion emerges, remember that not all rebels are visible. Rebel spies can do damage if you are not prepared...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若叛乱兴起，记住并非所有叛军都可见。你若毫无防备，叛军间谍可造成破坏……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you are overthrown and the citizens demand a new leader, it is not all bad. You will loose control of your empire for a time, but after this time you will have a new and interesting scenario to deal with.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你被推翻、民众要求换一位新领袖，也未必全是坏事。你会暂时失去对帝国的控制，但此后你将面对一个全新而有趣的局面。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Bribing dissidents and city officials can buy you important time to deal with regional discontent!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：贿赂异见者与城市官员，能为你争取到应对地区不满的宝贵时间！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you decide that you need to deal with rebellion with bribery, remember that your corruption does not go unwatched...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你决定用贿赂来应对叛乱，记住你的腐败并非无人注视……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Bribery is an important strategic element in advanced Revolutions play.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：贿赂是高阶革命玩法中一个重要的战略要素。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you pay out cash to one city in order to keep it quiet, other cities may increase their disloyalty too...unless you pay up to them as well!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你为安抚一座城市而向其付出现金，其他城市也可能随之增加其不忠……除非你也向它们付钱！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Beware of the Domino Effect...If one city rebels, this can cascade into a regional or empire wide rebellion!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：当心多米诺效应……若一座城市叛乱，这可能连锁演变为地区性乃至全帝国的叛乱！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If a rebel movement has taken control of parts of your empire, do not be frustrated! Patiently wait until the time is right and hit back at the rebellion with your loyal army!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若一场叛军运动已控制了你帝国的部分地区，别气馁！耐心等到时机成熟，再以你忠诚的军队反击叛乱！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If parts of your empire have broken away under independent rule, make sure their leaders do not side with your enemies!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你帝国的部分地区已在独立统治下分裂出去，务必确保其领袖不会倒向你的敌人！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The speed of city growth is an important element in controlling the stability of your empire. Grow too big too fast and their will be rogue elements emerging, be sure of that!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：城市增长的速度是控制帝国稳定的一个重要因素。扩张太快太大，必定会有叛离分子涌现，这点毋庸置疑！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The speed of city growth is one important aspect of advanced Revolutions game play. Keep city growth capped if need be, but not too long either!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：城市增长的速度是高阶革命玩法的一个重要方面。有需要时给城市增长设个上限，但也别限制得太久！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The loyalty of the citizenry is more easily kept in check in a tightly knit well connected empire.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：在一个紧密团结、连通良好的帝国里，市民的忠诚更易于掌控。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Without question, the most difficult aspect of Revolutions management, is the issue of distant settlements and colonies. These need special attention.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：毫无疑问，革命管理中最棘手的方面，是遥远的定居点与殖民地的问题。这些需要特别关注。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: It is a common misconception that you cannot expand into a mighty global empire under Revolutions. You can! You just have to do it right!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：以为在革命下无法扩张成一个强大的全球帝国，是个常见的误解。你可以的！只要方法得当！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: War gathers it's own momentum, not just in conquest, but in the approval of your citizens. Keep it rolling with rewards for them, and they will support you!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：战争自会积聚它自己的势头，不只在征服中，也在你市民的支持中。以奖赏让势头滚动下去，他们便会支持你！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Religion plays a huge role in the stability of your society. Try to run your civics to match the religious needs of your society.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：宗教在你社会的稳定中扮演着巨大的角色。设法让你的政体契合你社会的宗教需求。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you are faced with an empire with many different faiths, fear not! So long as you don't attempt to run a theocracy or organised religious state, the people may really respect you!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你面对的是一个信仰众多的帝国，不必畏惧！只要你不试图推行神权政治或有组织的宗教国家，民众或许会真心敬重你！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you want religious purity in your empire, do it wisely but be extra vigilant to non-state religions taking hold!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你想让帝国宗教纯一，就明智行事，但要格外警惕非国教信仰的扎根！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Without question, the management of holy city sites is one of the biggest challenges in Revolutions.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：毫无疑问，圣城的管理是革命中最大的挑战之一。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Under Revolutions you can hold firm more than one holy city in your empire. Two holy cities is fine, the challenge accumulates as the number of holy sites increase!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：在革命下，你可以在帝国里稳守不止一座圣城。两座圣城尚可，随着圣地数目增加，挑战便会累积！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The tools you have to manage Revolutions are many. Civics, culture, surplus cash, infrastructure, wonders, military, luxuries, war success are but a few.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：你手中管理革命的工具很多。政体、文化、盈余现金、基建、奇观、军事、奢侈品、战争胜绩，不过是其中几项。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: It is a common misconception that Revolutions fundamentally changes the basic game play. It does not. It merely adds another strategic layer upon the game, the management of your people...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：以为革命从根本上改变了基本玩法，是个常见的误解。它并没有。它只是在游戏之上添加了另一个战略层面：对你民众的管理……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Keep in mind the distinction between the general apathetic citizenry who are dictated by happiness and health, from the dissident minorities that have their own agendas.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：记住要区分那些为幸福与健康所左右、普遍冷漠的市民，与那些自有其图谋的异见少数群体。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: A city may appear to be happy, but this may only be a surface manifestation. If their are many foreign nationals, the desire for independence by force can emerge anyway!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：一座城市看似满意，但这或许只是表象。若城中有许多外国国民，凭武力寻求独立的欲望仍可能滋生！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Distant settlements need special attention. Give them extras like cultural assets, defence assets and military support to ensure that you are looking after them!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：遥远的定居点需要特别关注。给它们额外的东西，如文化资产、防御资产与军事支援，以确保你照顾到了它们！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Your citizens like constant improvements to their circumstances. Stagnation is your biggest enemy, not the people!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：你的市民喜欢境况不断改善。停滞才是你最大的敌人，而非民众！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*:In big empires, it is often better to let a city or even a region break away. The break always may be weak and exploitable.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：在大帝国中，往往不如任由一座城市、甚至一整个地区分裂出去。分裂出去的一方往往孱弱而有机可乘。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: In Revolutions, you may think that it is the end for a leader and a nation if they are defeated. But it may not be! Leaders will go underground and re-emerge rather than be destroyed for all time.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：在革命中，你或许以为一位领袖与一个国家一旦战败便是末路。但未必如此！领袖会转入地下、再度崛起，而非永远覆灭。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you want to conquest an enemy, make sure you get every last one of them! Even a single remainder can re-emerge as a resistance movement!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你想征服一个敌人，务必把他们斩尽杀绝！哪怕只剩一个残余，也可能再度崛起为一场抵抗运动！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: A cultural victory strategy has a spin off in Revolutions. The people will love you and you may wait for rival super powers to implode...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：文化胜利战略在革命中另有妙处。民众会爱戴你，你或可静待对手超级强权自行内爆……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If word spreads that an empire has collapsed into anarchy and rebellion, try to exploit it. These foreign citizens can be won over to your cause more easily than if you were to conquest that empire.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若有一个帝国陷入无政府与叛乱的消息传开，设法加以利用。这些外国国民比你去征服那个帝国时更容易被你争取过来。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Without question, capturing cities and holding them is more difficult in Revolutions. Military strategy must always keep in mind long term domestic stability of newly acquired territories.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：毫无疑问，在革命中攻占城市并守住它们更为困难。军事战略必须时刻顾及新占领土的长期内政稳定。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: A long term unstable settlement along way from home is not a bad thing. So long as there is strong military presence, medium term cycles of anarchy are manageable.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：一处远离本土、长期不稳的定居点未必是坏事。只要有强大的军事存在，中期的无政府周期是可以管理的。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Distant holy city sites are always going to be tricky to hold unless you concede at least in part, to the faith of that city.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：遥远的圣城总是难以守住，除非你至少部分地向那座城市的信仰让步。

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: It is not always wise to eliminate every last barbarian city before they evolve into minor civs. You may need trading partners!
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：在蛮族城市进化为次级文明之前就将它们赶尽杀绝，未必总是明智之举。你或许需要贸易伙伴！

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: Start a game with only yourself! Competitors will emerge. Just make sure you turn off conquest and domination victory conditions!
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：开局只放你一个人！竞争者会涌现。只需确保关闭征服与统治胜利条件即可！

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: If a barbarian city emerges as a minor civilization, don't despair. Farm them accordingly and pounce on them if they are weak, for more rewards than if they had remained as barbarians!
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：若一座蛮族城市崛起为一个次级文明，别灰心。相应地把它们当作牧场经营，趁其孱弱时扑上去，所获奖赏比它们仍是蛮族时更丰厚！

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: Barbarians evolve into minor civilizations. Minor civilizations evolve into full blooded civilizations. At each stage, they get stronger, economically and militarily.
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：蛮族会进化为次级文明。次级文明会进化为羽翼丰满的文明。每一阶段，它们在经济与军事上都会更强。

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: If you are all alone on a continent, encourage not just one minor nation to emerge, but at least a third. You may need to trade in a tri-pact relationship. Binary pacts rarely work.
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：若你独处一片大陆，就不只鼓励一个次级国家、而至少鼓励第三个崛起。你或许需要在三方协定的关系中交易。双边协定鲜少奏效。

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: If a minor civ emerges in your region, be warned that your outlying settlements may begin to become more loyal to them, not you!
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：若一个次级文明在你的地区崛起，须警惕你边远的定居点或许会开始更忠于它们，而非你！

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: The emergence of minor civs with capable armies may appear unfair, but remember that they need something to ensure a chance of long term survival.
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：拥有强大军队的次级文明的崛起，看似不公，但记住它们需要某种东西来确保长期存续的机会。

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: A minor civ does all the things a full civ does, but is more primitive in sophistication. A minor civ is insular and will not talk with you for example.
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：次级文明做羽翼丰满的文明所做的一切，只是在精细程度上更为原始。例如，次级文明闭塞排外，不会与你交谈。

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: Yes it is irritating if a minor civ settles vast fields of wild dye, leaving you without!
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：没错，若一个次级文明占了大片野生染料的田地、害你没得用，是挺恼人的！

english: *Barbarian Civ Hint*: New world maps are great. The old world you are on will one day discover a fully viable new world that has evolved of itself.
chinese: *蛮族文明提示*：新世界地图很棒。你所在的旧世界有朝一日会发现一个自行进化而成、完全可行的新世界。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Try the game options "Start as Minors". If you like early warfare, it is the option of choice!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：试试游戏选项“以次级文明开局”。若你喜欢前期战事，这便是首选之项！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: There is no conspiracy in the "Start as Minors" option. You will make friends if you are influential enough!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：“以次级文明开局”选项里没有什么阴谋。只要你足够有影响力，就会交到朋友！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Lacking a little spice in your life? Try "Start as Minors" with "Aggressive AI". That should do it!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：生活缺了点调味？试试“以次级文明开局”配上“激进 AI”。那应该管用！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Revolutions games are more interesting and diverse than standard games. It is well worth writing down your game history turn by turn, in the autolog with the [ALT E] keystroke.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：革命游戏比标准游戏更有趣、更多样。很值得用 [ALT E] 按键在自动日志里逐回合记下你的游戏历程。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Hereditary Rule is not necessarily the answer to all your revolt problems! The character of this political system will mean that war will have to be more carefully thought out to win your kingdom's support.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：世袭统治未必是你一切叛乱问题的答案！这套政治体制的特性意味着，战争须得更审慎地谋划，方能赢得你王国的支持。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Despotism is a viable option! A despot has less ethical issues to deal with so long as his people can be kept in the dark about them! A despot can win wars when a King cannot!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：专制是一个可行的选项！只要能把民众蒙在鼓里，专制者要应对的道德问题就更少！国王赢不了的战争，专制者能赢！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Pay particular attention to the labour reforms your society adopts. It is these that the people must work under!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：格外留意你社会所采纳的劳工改革。正是这些，民众须得在其下劳作！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: The Sevopedia now displays revolutions specific civic effects and leader traits can be customised for revolution effects!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：塞沃佩迪亚如今会显示革命专属的政体效果，领袖特性也可针对革命效果加以定制！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Don't be scared to run slavery! The citizens will endure the whipping.....for a time!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：别怕实行奴隶制！市民会忍受鞭打……忍上一阵子！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Really, in a diverse religious state, you wouldn't run organised religion, would you?
chinese: *革命模组提示*：说真的，在一个信仰多元的国家，你不会推行有组织的宗教，对吧？

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you really want democracy, have it! But reform doesn't end there!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你真想要民主，那就实行！但改革并不止步于此！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Switching to a police state may be good at times of instability! How else can you keep the empire under your thumb?
chinese: *革命模组提示*：在动荡之时，切换到警察国家或许有益！不然你还能怎么把帝国牢牢攥在手心？

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: There is nothing more fun than to slowly destabilise a super power by stagnating it, and to grab the spoils when it implodes!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：没有什么比慢慢令一个超级强权停滞、使其失稳，再在它内爆时攫取战利品更有趣的了！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Che Guevara is the symbol for this mod! Play the game like he did, and you should be fine!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：切·格瓦拉是这个模组的象征！像他那样玩这游戏，你应该就没问题！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you are sick of constant rebellious uprisings against you, don't forget [CTRL-SHIFT-L] and you can switch over to the rebels side!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你厌倦了针对你无休止的叛乱起义，别忘了 [CTRL-SHIFT-L]，你可以倒向叛军一方！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you think about it, a mod that makes the game more difficult like Revolutions, also makes the game more rewarding...
chinese: *革命模组提示*：细想之下，一个像革命这样让游戏更难的模组，也让游戏更有回报……

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you have stabilised your domestic society and you are the leader the people want, any standard BTS strategy is available for you to implement.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你已稳住了你的内政社会、又是民众想要的领袖，那么任何标准的《超越剑锋》战略你都可以实施。

english: *DCM Hint*: Catapults cannot range bombard.
chinese: *DCM 提示*：投石车无法进行远程轰击。

english: *DCM Hint*: Range bombarding cities has a slightly different effect to bombarding them directly. Range bombarding aims fire at the defenders of the city as well as the defences!
chinese: *DCM 提示*：远程轰击城市与直接轰击城市的效果略有不同。远程轰击既瞄准城防，也瞄准城市的守军！

english: *DCM Hint*: Range bombarding cities has much less impact on the defenders than the defences of the city. Defenders can seek cover even behind damaged walls!....for a time...
chinese: *DCM 提示*：远程轰击城市对守军的影响远小于对城防的影响。守军即便躲在受损的城墙后也能寻得掩护！……忍上一阵子……

english: *DCM Hint*: If you want to take down a cities defences at maximum thrift, just straight bombard the city defences and leave the defenders until there is no where for them to hide.
chinese: *DCM 提示*：若你想以最省的方式摧毁一座城市的防御，就直接轰击城防，把守军放到无处可藏时再说。

english: *DCM Hint*: If you are defending your precious city from an enemy stack, range bombard the attackers as best you can from inside the city, but remember that your accuracy is compromised by being behind city structures and impediments.
chinese: *DCM 提示*：若你正从敌方叠层手中保卫你宝贵的城市，就尽力从城内远程轰击进攻者，但记住，身处城市建筑与障碍之后会削弱你的精度。

english: *DCM Hint*: Properly set-up defensive structures like forts or field deployments with properly constructed frontlines, are by far the most effective way to range bombard.
chinese: *DCM 提示*：布置得当的防御工事，如堡垒、或以妥善构筑的前线做野战部署，是迄今为止进行远程轰击最有效的方式。

english: *DCM Hint*: Range bombard now only issues standard BTS collateral damage upon stacks. It is completely useless against single units and siege as well as the head defender of the enemy stack.
chinese: *DCM 提示*：远程轰击如今只对叠层造成标准《超越剑锋》的溅射伤害。它对单个单位、攻城器械以及敌方叠层的首席守军完全无效。

english: *DCM Hint*: When thinking about range bombardment and how it causes damage, imagine the battle scenario. Range bombard tends to hit the main throng of the enemy army, missing the frontline attackers and not reaching the counter siege at the rear!
chinese: *DCM 提示*：思考远程轰击及其如何造成伤害时，想象一下战斗场景。远程轰击往往击中敌军的主力人群，错过前线的进攻者，也够不到后方的反攻城器械！

english: *DCM Hint*: Range bombardment effect can be customised in GlobalDefinesAlt.xml
chinese: *DCM 提示*：远程轰击的效果可在 GlobalDefinesAlt.xml 中定制。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Try the Barbarian world option where barbs sometimes start with cities in place at game start! This can make them more competitive but also give you a nice early target for conquest!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：试试蛮族世界选项，蛮族有时会在游戏开局便已建有城市！这能让它们更具竞争力，也给你一个前期征服的好目标！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: Revolutions and it's components are configurable and customisable in Revolution.ini
chinese: *革命模组提示*：革命及其各组件可在 Revolution.ini 中配置和定制。

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: If you want an interesting variation of Revolutions, that effectively turns down the overall difficulty of the mod, try the "Inquisitions" option or "Limited Religions" or both!
chinese: *革命模组提示*：若你想要革命的一种有趣变体，实际上会降低模组整体的难度，试试“宗教裁判”选项、或“有限宗教”，或两者兼用！

english: *Revolutions Mod Hint*: From most difficult to least difficult are: Straight Revolutions, Limited Religions or Inquisitions, Limited Religion and Inquisitions.
chinese: *革命模组提示*：由难到易依次为：纯革命、有限宗教或宗教裁判、有限宗教与宗教裁判并用。

english: *Influence Driven War*: If you need to ensure you keep your borders intact, you may have to get out from behind city fortification and fight in the field!
chinese: *影响驱动战争*：若你需要确保边界完好，你或许得走出城市工事、在野外作战！

english: *Influence Driven War*: If you have a choice of where you want to fight, pick a location that will be most useful to you so that if you win the battle, your influence around the battle region is good enough to keep the territory!
chinese: *影响驱动战争*：若你能选择交战地点，就挑一个对你最有利的位置，这样你若打赢，你在战斗区域周边的影响力便足以守住那片领土！

english: *Influence Driven War*: Keep an eye out for the culture mix of the tile you are contesting. It is possible that a 5% influence swing to you may be enough to win the territory!
chinese: *影响驱动战争*：留意你所争夺地块的文化构成。区区 5% 的影响力偏移向你，就可能足以赢下那片领土！

english: *RevolutionDCM*: All game options are configurable within the user interface. Most are accessible via the BUG hot key [CTRL-ALT-O] under the "RevDCM" tab.
chinese: *革命 DCM*：所有游戏选项都可在用户界面内配置。多数可通过 BUG 热键 [CTRL-ALT-O] 在“RevDCM”标签页下访问。

english: *RevolutionDCM*: If you select the "debug" option under the RevDCM tab, game options will update on the next turn!
chinese: *革命 DCM*：若你在 RevDCM 标签页下选中“调试”选项，游戏选项将在下回合更新！

english: *RevolutionDCM*: Some game options like enabling or disabling Revolutions, can only be done at the start of a game in the custom game screen.
chinese: *革命 DCM*：某些游戏选项，如启用或禁用革命，只能在游戏开局的自定义游戏界面中设置。

english: *Super Spies*: Be wary of counter espionage! AI's are very conscious about it against adversaries they do not trust. This will make you more vulnerable to espionage if ignored and more expensive for you to conduct!
chinese: *超级间谍*：警惕反间谍！AI 对它们不信任的对手在这方面极为上心。若忽视此点，你会更易受谍报侵袭，你自己行动的花费也更高！

english: *Super Spies*: Experiment with different combinations of spy promotions. Who knows, you might end up with your own James Bond!
chinese: *超级间谍*：试验不同的间谍晋升组合。谁知道呢，你说不定会培养出你自己的詹姆斯·邦德！

english: *Super Spies*: Once the era of bureaucratic espionage is possible, security bureau's and intelligence agencies matter!
chinese: *超级间谍*：一旦官僚化谍报的时代成为可能，安全局与情报机构便举足轻重！

english: Introduction to the Revolution Mod
chinese: 革命模组简介

english: Welcome to the Revolution![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This mod consists of several different pieces which work together to make Civ4 more dynamic, with empires rising and falling more throughout the game.  Below are some brief descriptions and hints for playing with this mod:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]
chinese: 欢迎来到革命！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]这个模组由若干协同运作的部分组成，让《文明 IV》更为动态，帝国在整局游戏中兴衰起落更为频繁。以下是玩此模组的一些简要说明与提示：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]

english: Revolution
chinese: 革命

english: This is the main component of the mod and affects the internal stability of your and every other empire.  Keeping the citizens of your empire content is now a bigger issue, as if a city feels they have been mistreated they may rebel against you!  The new Revolution Watch screen can help you keep track of how your citizens are feeling and can be opened either by using the button below the advisor buttons or by pressing Ctrl+Shift+W.  This screen shows which cities are feeling rebelious and why they do or don't like your current policies.  This info can also be found in the city screen near the culture bar and moving your cursor over the new Revolut Status bar will bring up specific information about the city.  There are many different reasons why your citizens can love or hate living in your empire and keeping them happy and patriotic adds a new dimension to managing your empire.  One tool you have if you need to buy time or avoid a pending revolt is the ability to make a large cash 'donation' to a city, the options for this can be accessed either through the Revolution Watch screen or by clicking on the Revolt Status bar in the city screen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If some of your citizens disagree with your policies or want to separate from your empire, you'll be presented with a popup offering you a choice on how to respond to their demands.  There are many different kinds of demands your citizens may make, from changes to your civics to complete freedom on cultural or religious grounds, and for each type of revolt there are multiple ways you can respond.  You can always avoid outright war or force the separatists to fight for their freedom.  If you defeat them on the battle field, they will think twice before revolting again.  However, you will eventually need to address the issues that cause them to revolt or potentially face a protracted civil war.  Your allies and enemies will also face the possibilities of open revolts, which can present opportunities for you in many different ways and other leaders can also lose elections or be forced to cede power control of their empire to another leader.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Playing with Revolution may require you to adjust your strategies for building up your empire or conquering foreign territory.  Some general guidelines are that building your culture and spreading your religion are now more important to help keep your empire cohesive.  Strong defenses and victory in war can also keep your empire doing well.  Over expansion is more risky and an empire that spends too much commerce on taxes will not last for long.  Picking civics that suit your empire is also important.  Check the Revolution Watch screen and the status bars in your cities to see what issues your citizens have and head them off before they boil over into open revolt.
chinese: 这是模组的主要组件，影响着你及其他每个帝国的内部稳定。让你帝国的市民满意如今是个更重大的问题，因为一座城市若觉得自己受了亏待，便可能起来反抗你！全新的革命监视界面能帮你追踪市民的情绪，可通过顾问按钮下方的按钮、或按 Ctrl+Shift+W 打开。此界面会显示哪些城市心怀叛意，以及它们为何喜欢或不喜欢你当前的政策。这些信息也可在城市界面的文化条附近找到，把光标移到全新的革命状态条上，便会显示该城市的具体信息。你的市民爱或恨在你帝国中生活，缘由多种多样，让他们既幸福又心怀爱国，为管理你的帝国增添了一个全新的维度。若你需要争取时间或避免一场迫在眉睫的叛乱，你手中有一件工具，便是向一座城市做一大笔现金“捐赠”，其选项可通过革命监视界面、或点击城市界面中的叛乱状态条来访问。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]若你的一些市民不认同你的政策、或想脱离你的帝国，你会看到一个弹窗，供你选择如何回应他们的诉求。你的市民可能提出各式各样的诉求，从更改你的政体到以文化或宗教为由完全独立，对每一类叛乱，你都有多种回应方式。你总能避免公然开战，或迫使分裂者为其自由而战。若你在战场上击败他们，他们再想叛乱便会三思。然而，你最终仍须应对导致他们叛乱的问题，否则可能面临一场旷日持久的内战。你的盟友与敌人也将面临公然叛乱的可能，这能以多种方式为你带来机会，其他领袖也可能败选，或被迫将其帝国的控制权让予另一位领袖。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]玩革命或许要求你调整建设帝国或征服外国领土的战略。一些通用的准则是：建设你的文化、传播你的宗教如今更为重要，有助于保持你帝国的凝聚。坚固的防御与战争的胜利也能让你的帝国维持良好。过度扩张风险更大，一个在税收上耗费过多商业的帝国不会长久。挑选契合你帝国的政体也很重要。查看革命监视界面与你城市中的状态条，看你的市民有何问题，在它们沸腾成公然叛乱之前将其化解。
